1: -module(hty_override_resource_SUITE).
    2: 
    3: -export([
    4:         all/0,
    5:         get_root_test/0,
    6:         override_test/0,
    7:         fail_on_other_filename_test/0,
    8:         fail_on_other_filename_deep_test/0
    9:     ]).
   10: 
   11: htx(Path) ->
   12:     H = hty_tx_factory:get(Path).
   13: %  H1 = H:method('GET'),
   14: %  H2 = H1:path({[], Path}),
   15: %  H2.
   16: 
   17: dut() ->
   18:     Folder = hty_fspath:new("test/testdata/hty_override_resource"),
   19:     hty_override_resource:new("data.txt", Folder).
   20:     
   21: all() -> [
   22:     get_root_test,
   23:     override_test,
   24:     fail_on_other_filename_test, 
   25:     fail_on_other_filename_deep_test
   26: ].
   27:     
   28: 
   29: get_root_test() ->
   30:     Htx = htx(<<"data.txt">>),
   31:     Dut = dut(),
   32:     Htx1 = hty_tx:dispatch([Dut], Htx),
   33:     {200, _} = hty_tx:status(Htx1),
   34:     [{file, "test/testdata/hty_override_resource/data.txt"}|_] = hty_tx:outs(Htx1).
   35: 
   36: override_test() ->
   37:     Htx = htx(<<"sub1/data.txt">>),
   38:     Dut = dut(),
   39:     Htx1 = hty_tx:dispatch([Dut], Htx),
   40:     {200, _} = hty_tx:status(Htx1),
   41:     [{file, "test/testdata/hty_override_resource/sub1/data.txt"}|_] = hty_tx:outs(Htx1).
   42: 
   43: fail_on_other_filename_test() ->
   44:     Htx = htx(<<"otherfile.txt">>),
   45:     Dut = dut(),
   46:     Htx1 = hty_tx:dispatch([Dut], Htx),
   47:     {404, _} = hty_tx:status(Htx1).
   48: 
   49: fail_on_other_filename_deep_test() ->
   50:     Htx = htx(<<"sub1/otherfile.txt">>),
   51:     Dut = dut(),
   52:     Htx1 = hty_tx:dispatch([Dut], Htx),
   53:     {404, _} = hty_tx:status(Htx1).
